summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on diagnosing slow performance in the staging environment. [me] inquired about ongoing slowdowns. [p12] noted that the slowness seemed to start after accessing the campaign section, specifically when loading a list of users with campaign rights, which took half a second to load.

[p6] suggested having someone test and pinpoint where the delay occurs, mentioning that displaying user permissions might be resource-intensive. [p1] began testing by checking the manager display for 'bistro' on a test campaign, and [p6] advised testing various functions, including editing rights, to identify potential bottlenecks.
decisions: Test performance issues in the staging environment related to user permissions and campaigns.
action_items: [p12] will check the campaign section for performance issues.
[p1] will continue testing various functions, including editing rights, on a test campaign.
